issue.title: Client Cannot GET /xxx.html before accessing main

CATEGORY: 1
REASONING: This issue is about Express.js routing behavior and static file serving. The problem is clear from the code: the `express.static` middleware is being set up inside the `/main` route handler instead of being configured globally for the application. This means static files are only available after the `/main` route has been accessed. The solution would be to move the static file middleware outside of any route handler, which is a standard Express.js configuration practice. This is a conceptual issue that can be verified through code analysis without needing to build or run the application. An LLM can identify that the `app.use(express.static(__dirname))` line should be moved outside of the route handler to make static files accessible regardless of which routes have been previously accessed. No build environment is necessary to verify this solution.
